_source: design_system/v1_0_threejs_soulslike/TUNING_V0.md § Tincture + DECISIONS.md D6 + TEXT_BIBLE.md §2/§3. Keys prefixed with _ are provenance notes and are stripped before the data<->code parity comparison (see data.parity.test.ts).

vial._source: TUNING_V0 § Tincture verbatim: 'Slice doses: 3 base, +1 per Hearth upgrade tier (pouch materials).' maxUpgradeTier 2 authored (slice reach: 5 doses).

variants._source: Kinds are TUNING_V0 verbatim (instant / over-time / cleanse-Turn / Breath surge + brief Steady / large heal + deferred instability). Magnitudes are AUTHORED (TUNING_V0 gives no Tincture magnitudes); ER-calibrated against maxPulse base 300 in progression_params.json. Feel gate owns final numbers.

ember._source: DECISIONS D6 + TUNING_V0 verbatim: 2 doses in slice, non-craftable, full Pulse+Breath restore + Turn cleanse + 20s surge (1200t at 60Hz). Surge magnitudes AUTHORED. surgeSteadyDelta 15 > cedar_wool_compress 12 so Ember dominates every craftable dose on every restoration axis (D6 canon law: Ember must be genuinely wanted).

numbness._source: DECISIONS D6 + TUNING_V0 verbatim: -8% Tincture healing, +25% Turn buildup, +1 register step per permanent stack. maxTextStep 3 and maxVigilRestore 1 from TEXT_BIBLE §2 (textStep = clamp(stacks - vigilRestore, 0, 3); vigilRestore is 1 while the current Hearth vigil holds).

pouch._source: TEXT_BIBLE §3 'The pouch (15 entries, folk order - v0.3 §V/§X verbatim)'. Ember is the 15th entry and is the Ember dose count (single source of truth). Starting counts AUTHORED.

recipes._source: AUTHORED. TEXT_BIBLE §3 card descriptions drive the ingredient logic (honey 'carries a bitter dose past the tongue'; salt 'for the wash'; cedar+wool for the compress; zyl numbs the hands for Bitter Phrine). Craft at the Hearth only (DECISIONS D6: the Tincture Wheel is Hearth work).

ambientWither._source: TUNING_V0 § Warden / the road: 'Ambient Wither 0.5/s off-path in the deep wood.' 60 Hz tick. Exact fraction: 0.5/60 = 1/120 per tick (0.00833…). 600 ticks × 1/120 = 5.
